10th - Andrew 1/28/2025 2:01 PM
OK chefs, today I made for you a paprika baked chicken with a tomato reduction and a truffle sauce. Because my dish is supposed to resemble one that resides over the pits of hell, I decided to give my main focus of the meal, the chicken, that smoky red flavoring and coloring of paprika dusted on top. I also rub some oil on top of it just to get that crispy layer of skin that resembles the hot flames of the fiery pits of hell burning the top layer of your skin. Don’t worry, though I did season the under parts of the skin as well with some more paprika, dried garlic, salt, and pepper just because the chicken does need more flavoring besides just the top surface. My chicken is swimming on top of a thin layer of tomato reduction. This resembles the Phlegethon (A river of blood that boils the souls) I made the reduction by baking tomatoes until they were tender and skin splitting, then I added them to the blender with garlic, black pepper, salt and a golden brown, sautéed onion. To compliment the red coloring, I added a white truffle sauce to give it a splash of color that resembles all the white supremacists that belong there. The truffle sauce was made with truffles, oil, and heavy whipping cream with some salt and black pepper.

https://www.mysugarfreekitchen.com/smoked-paprika-chicken/
Spicy Smoked Paprika Chicken - Better Than KFC!
Oven baked crispy Smoked Paprika Chicken is like a healthy KFC. 5 min to prepare, on the table in 40 mins. Uses a quick and easy DIY Smoked Paprika Rub.
10th - Andrew
OK chefs, today I made for you a paprika baked chicken with a tomato reduction and a truffle sauce. Because my dish is supposed to resemble one that resides over the pits of hell, I decided to give my main focus of the meal, the chicken, that smoky red flavoring and coloring of paprika dusted on top. I also rub some oil on top of it just to get that crispy layer of skin that resembles the hot flames of the fiery pits of hell burning the top layer of your skin. Don’t worry, though I did season the under parts of the skin as well with some more paprika, dried garlic, salt, and pepper just because the chicken does need more flavoring besides just the top surface. My chicken is swimming on top of a thin layer of tomato reduction. This resembles the Phlegethon (A river of blood that boils the souls) I made the reduction by baking tomatoes until they were tender and skin splitting, then I added them to the blender with garlic, black pepper, salt and a golden brown, sautéed onion. To compliment the red coloring, I added a white truffle sauce to give it a splash of color that resembles all the white supremacists that belong there. The truffle sauce was made with truffles, oil, and heavy whipping cream with some salt and black pepper.
